start: Linked member with a running plan; the gym has an open workout offer

user_sees: Offers card 'From <gym> · Offer', 'Train <n> times in <w> days, get <d> extra days', 'Check in at the gym and log a workout of <min>+ minutes with <sets>+ sets.' and 'Join the offer'
must_not: 'hurry' or 'last chance' words, or '1 extra days'

user_sees: Consent screen 'Join: <n> workouts, <d> extra days' with How it works, 'What the gym gets: only the dates of those workouts. Never your exercises, weights, sets, body weight or photos.', who sees it, how to stop, complaints; buttons 'Join the offer' and 'Not now'
must_not: Anything sent before the second 'Join the offer' tap

user_sees: The card shows '<c> of <n> workouts', 'Until <date>', 'Counts on days you check in at the gym.' and 'Leave the offer'
must_not: Joined without the consent version sent to the gym

steps.action: Check in and log counted workouts until the goal
user_sees: '<n> of <n>. The desk will add <d> days to your membership.', later 'Added: your plan now ends on <date>.'
must_not: Any exercise, weight or set leaving the phone; a workout under the gym's minutes/sets counted

start: Member not joined; shows workouts to the desk with the claim code ('Show my workouts to the desk')

steps.action: Open 'Show my workouts to the desk'
user_sees: A 10-character code like 'K3Q9P-X2M7A' holding the last 30 days with a counted workout (app-logged, 20+ minutes, 6+ working sets)
must_not: An imported, demo or chat-logged workout counted; anything sent over the internet

steps.action: Desk types the code into the member's page
user_sees: The admin app reads the days and matches them to check-ins ('9 of 10 match')
must_not: A typo accepted as another member's days

start: The offer reaches the member as a pop-up notification

user_sees: The Gym tab with the Offers card
must_not: The consent skipped by the notification tap

steps.action: Tap 'Join the offer' with no check-in linked / no running plan / a roster mismatch
user_sees: "Check in once with the gym's QR poster to join." / 'You can join while your plan is running. Ask at the desk.' / 'Ask at the desk to join this offer.'
must_not: A join saved, or a raw code like NAME_MISMATCH

steps.action: Join after the offer closed, or offline
user_sees: 'This offer has closed. Ask at the desk.' / "No internet. Try again when you're online."
must_not: The card showing joined after a failed join

user_sees: 'Not joining changes nothing about your membership.'; nothing is sent
must_not: A consent row written for 'Not now'

start: Joined member leaves the offer; offer ends

user_sees: 'Leave the offer?' and 'Your workout dates are deleted from the gym, and nothing more is sent. Your membership does not change.' with 'Leave the offer' / 'Stay in'
must_not: Dates still at the gym after the leave is confirmed

user_sees: The leave is kept and sent again before anything else next time
must_not: More dates sent after the member left

steps.action: The offer window ends short of the goal
user_sees: 'The offer ended at <c> of <n>. You came <c> times in <w> days. Nice work.'
must_not: '1 times', or extra days promised

user_sees: The owner and front desk of this gym see only the dates of counted workouts
must_not: Exercises, weights, sets, body weight or photos visible; another gym seeing the dates

user_sees: Consent, pending leave and kept card are erased from the phone; dates deleted at the gym
must_not: The offer card of the old gym shown after leaving
